STAGE: read the four frozen bundles and the rubric
GOAL: establish which claims in each proposal are grounded in the frozen evidence versus asserted only in the motivation.
READ: bundle 2ec8dfb2e08a4282 (nullcurv-hinge-rq), 69fae840a943a6a9 (CURVALLOC-LORENTZ-RQ), 7d383ca4ae78e044 (ORC-CELLCHART), e07e5e8696f932e4 (CURVPROF-TRANSPORT-RQ); rubric rank-2026-10-v1.
OBSERVED: the four behavioural bundles are numerically identical (E5-E11 byte-for-byte the same text), so no proposal is separated by behaviour evidence. Every geometric entry E12/E13 in all four is tagged PROPOSED, so no bundle contains a measured curvature-to-recall number: the +0.26 / -0.16 / -0.20 slope cited by all four motivations is NOT in the frozen bundle. The only OBSERVED discriminators available are therefore: E6 width-20 beam survival (best arm resample recall@10 0.06363, l1_only 0.06233, l1_br_euclid 0.06207, successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500, tangent_successor_residual 0.05500, successor_entropy 0.05122, l1_br 0.04671; gold prefix alive at depth 1/2/3/4: l1_br 1.000/1.000/1.000/0.068, l1_br_euclid 1.000/0.829/0.161/0.085, resample 0.497/0.122/0.091/0.088), E7 teacher-forced NLL (l1_br T1/T2/T3 = 0.00/0.00/0.00 with depth-1 survival 1.000 = degenerate coarse prefix), E8 first-level capacity ceiling (K=16 shares a cluster 0.3106 vs K=256 0.0822), E9 cohort-profile signal (0.9291 vs 0.8871), E10 edge density 5.33.
REASONING: with no measured curvature-recall evidence, the ranking must be carried by (i) whether the proposal measures curvature on the prefix quotient that E6/E7 actually stress, (ii) whether the perturbation has a guard against the E6/E7-visible collapse mode (l1_br: perfect prefix survival, degeneracy, 0.04671), and (iii) whether constants are derived rather than tuned, per the binding experiment policy. The target 0.065 sits above the best observed arm 0.06363, and E6 shows depth-2/3 prefix survival (0.829 -> 0.156/0.161) is the real bottleneck, not raw curvature.
OPEN: per-proposal scope and soundness check, then positions.

STAGE: per-proposal scope / soundness / evidence-alignment check before placing them
GOAL: decide positions 1-4 with a reason each that names evidence.
READ: the four specifications, cost blocks and risk lists; bundle E6/E7/E8 (the only OBSERVED discriminators, identical in all four bundles).
OBSERVED / REASONING:
- CURVPROF-TRANSPORT-RQ: measures the behaviour-curvature on the prefix quotient induced by the current SID (E1/E2), which is the object E6/E7 stress; changes only c_l of the Poincare ball in which the residual Moebius log is taken, so removal of behaviour (c_l fixed) or replacement by the flat limit changes the code chosen at levels 2 and 3, not just a loss value — the only proposal that states the three-way comparison as a code-choice statement. Explicit constant provenance (m from measured spread, sign from the measured L1<L3 evidence, clip = two standardised units, occupancy floor K/2, cadence as a stated 61-computation cost budget) is the only one that meets the no-sweep policy on its face. Cheapest step overhead (+5-10%, ~2-4 min total) and a K/2 occupancy floor that speaks directly to the E6/E7 collapse signature (l1_br depth survival 1.000/1.000/1.000 with T1/T2/T3 NLL 0.00 and recall 0.04671). Targets the depth-2/3 survival cliff (0.829 -> 0.156/0.161) that separates the 0.062-0.064 arms from the 0.047-0.055 arms.
- CURVALLOC-LORENTZ-RQ: also works on the prefix quotient and is the only one whose stated aim (keep level-3 used-code count up, do not collapse level 1) matches the E6/E7 failure mode; each level owns a proper global hyperboloid, so the assignment stays a genuine metric. But the behaviour-to-geometry map is stop-gradient and only 15 refreshes deep: the loop is real (removing behaviour flattens c_l and rho_l to c0/rho0 and changes the partition) yet it is a schedule rather than a gradient coupling, and the proposal itself concedes the SIGN of the map may be wrong, which a single run cannot correct. It also closely re-uses the per-level controller shape; no usage floor, only a falsification threshold (~8 level-1 codes), and clip +-1 / EMA 0.5 are documented defaults rather than derived quantities. Hence 2, not 1.
- nullcurv-hinge-rq: strongest safeguard design (r_max squash, tau = 1/sqrt(c_l), sigma floor, level-3 usage >= 0.9x epoch-0) and a genuine closed loop, since c_l both selects codes and is trained by the curvature of the partition it produces; the hinge margin 0 and lambda = L_RQ(0)/L_curv(0) are derived, not tuned. But its own risk 2 states the target is measured on the K-node code-marginal quotient, not the prefix-tuple quotient of the forensics, so it optimises a different object from the one E6/E7 point at; the lever is three scalars; level-3 sigma near zero and arccosh gradients at coincident codes are exactly the E6/E7 collapse mode; and the per-step Sinkhorn/lazy-walk surrogate is noisy. Low capacity to lift a 0.06363-best baseline past 0.065. Hence 3.
- ORC-CELLCHART: most direct attack on collisions and level-3 usage, but assigning each codeword its own curvature magnitude makes the nearest-code rule a family of incomparable metrics — the softmax over d_{k_{l,c}}(z, e_c) mixes scales, so it is no longer a distance-based assignment at all. Heaviest refresh budget (600 refreshes x 20 nulls x 3 levels x Sinkhorn) for a mechanism whose gain is unverified; winsorising at +-3 with a +-4x clip can binarise the field (its own risk); and although its risk list names the Issue #127 level-1 shrink explicitly, no usage guard is specified, unlike the two proposals above. Given E6/E7 show the failure is silent (depth survival 1.000 while recall falls to 0.04671), an unguarded per-code perturbation is the least defensible single run. Hence 4.
OPEN: emit the ranking in the required four-line format and record it as the final entry.

STAGE: final answer (complete, stands alone)
GOAL: deliver the ranking of all four proposals, best first, one line each, grounded in the frozen bundles.
OBSERVED: the four bundles are numerically identical on behaviour evidence (E5-E11) and all geometric entries (E12/E13) are PROPOSED, so no measured curvature-recall number exists in the bundle; the only OBSERVED discriminators are E6 beam survival (best arm 0.06363 vs target 0.065, degenerate l1_br 0.04671 with depth survival 1.000/1.000/1.000), E7 per-position NLL (l1_br T1/T2/T3 = 0.00), and E8 capacity ceiling (K=16 0.3106 vs K=256 0.0822).
RESULT (also recorded verbatim below as the deliverable):
RANK: CURVPROF-TRANSPORT-RQ | position=1 | reason=Only proposal that couples behaviour to geometry through a per-level statement of code choice on the prefix quotient the evidence actually stresses: E6 shows the arms that keep depth-2 prefix survival finite (0.829 with recall 0.062) beat the degenerate l1_br (1.000/1.000/1.000 survival, 0.04671), and this is the only one whose curvature enters the residual transport at levels 2-3 so that behaviour-off or flat-limit changes the assignment, with derived constants (measured spread, L1<L3 sign, two-standardised-unit clip, K/2 occupancy floor, 61-computation cadence), a K/2 guard against the E6/E7 collapse signature, and the smallest added cost (+5-10% step, 2-4 min).
RANK: CURVALLOC-LORENTZ-RQ | position=2 | reason=Measured on the prefix quotient with a legitimate global hyperboloid per level and aimed at the E6/E7 failure mode (keep level-3 used codes up, do not collapse level 1), but the behaviour->curvature/radius allocation is stop-gradient over only 15 refreshes and it concedes the sign of the map may be wrong, which a single run cannot repair; clip +-1 and EMA 0.5 are documented defaults rather than derived, and there is no usage floor, only a stated falsification threshold near 8 level-1 codes.
RANK: nullcurv-hinge-rq | position=3 | reason=Genuine closed loop with derived margin 0 and lambda = L_RQ(0)/L_curv(0) and the best guard set (r_max squash, tau = 1/sqrt(c_l), sigma floor, level-3 usage >= 0.9x epoch-0), but its own risk 2 admits the hinge is measured on the K-node code-marginal quotient rather than the prefix-tuple quotient that E6/E7 implicate, so it optimises a different object; the lever is three scalars, level-3 sigma near zero and arccosh gradients at coincident codes are precisely the E6/E7 collapse mode, and a 0.06363-best baseline needs more than a 3-scalar nudge to clear 0.065.
RANK: ORC-CELLCHART | position=4 | reason=Directly targets collisions and level-3 usage, but a per-codeword curvature magnitude makes the nearest-code rule a family of incomparable metrics so the assignment softmax mixes scales, it carries the heaviest refresh budget (600 refreshes x 20 nulls x 3 levels) of any arm, winsorising at +-3 inside a +-4x clip can binarise the field, and although its risk list names the Issue #127 level-1 shrink it specifies no usage guard -- the exact silent failure E6/E7 document (depth survival 1.000 while recall falls to 0.04671) -- making it the least defensible single run.
